variants.briefing:
An informant passed along some interesting news. XenoThreat are about to do a massive ammo resupply run for their forces, and in preparation, they’ve brought all that cargo to [Location]. Seems like a prime time to strike. You interested in killing a bunch of Xenos and then stealing their ammo for us?    

If so, get your shit in order and then clear that base. Once done, grab all the ammo and bring it to [Destination]. You’ll get paid well, and I’m sure we’ll find something fun to do with all that ammo. 

Stows out.
